AI module shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, or generated opportunities, suggesting it might not be functioning correctly.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI module configuration and ensure it is properly integrated and functioning to generate trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and address any underlying issues such as inefficient processes or resource contention.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI module to identify and resolve any issues preventing it from learning and generating opportunities.
